user.title: Connect CellGate
user.description: Sign in with your CellGate account to add your gate using the mobile API.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to CellGate or read its response.
error.invalid_auth: CellGate rejected the credentials or session.
error.no_gates: No visible gate output ports were found for this account.

init.title: Intercom calls
init.description: Connect the CellGate Intercom Asterisk backend. Opening this camera answers an incoming call. Closing a viewer leaves the intercom call active; reopen the same camera during that call. Install the companion service first, then enter its URL (normally http://HOME_ASSISTANT_IP:28190) and its independent API token. Mobile app coexistence and real CellGate media remain experimental.

error.backend_auth: The backend API token must match the companion service and contain at least 32 characters.
error.backend_unavailable: Unable to reach a ready CellGate Intercom backend. Use the companion service URL, including its port.
